_comment: Inputs of the GeoCity geometry node group. Every key is the socket name as it appears on
the modifier; unknown keys are reported and ignored, so a preset stays readable when the
node group gains or loses a socket. The values below are the node group's own defaults,
spelled out so that a generated city is reproducible from its preset alone.
'Seed' is what makes two cities from the same road graph differ; vary it, not the graph,
